svg.title: A sunset gradient on the inner forearm in four pictures. 1: dab the light color, yellow, over the whole patch. 2: load orange and red side by side and dab them over the right half, overlapping the yellow. 3: dab the overlap with the cleaner edge of the sponge until it is smooth. Done: yellow fading to orange and red, with the outer edges dabbed lightly so they fade into the skin.
